canonical_s2_mechanism: The root Bamboo model partitions concurrently running child S1s into narrow, non-overlapping responsibilities and authoritative mutation scopes/workspaces, then uses child status, completion and error feedback to steer, update, rerun, cancel or otherwise change subsequent child behavior.

upstream_eval_issue.title: [bamboo] eval: measure SubAgent delegation-contract behavior
upstream_eval_issue.planned_control: Freeze equivalent pre-contract control and post-contract treatment prompts with equivalent tasks, models, runtime and tool permissions.
upstream_eval_issue.planned_repetition: Repeated trials sufficient to report variance rather than a single anecdote.

reopen_when: Bamboo or a successor first-party public evaluation publishes recoverable result artifacts that directly measure interaction-specific scope/assignment interference and its attenuation through Bamboo's native or adapter-preserved S2 path, with enough provenance to classify the observation and any comparison cell without Opensiro-operated reproduction.
do_not_reopen_for: completion of the upstream issue without public recoverable result artifacts
generic task-success or latency measurements without an explicit inter-S1 disturbance and attenuation variable
mechanism tests that only prove the SubAgent coordination contract exists
an Opensiro-operated Bamboo benchmark or reproduction
non_claim: This review does not score Bamboo S2 capability, admit an observation, change Bamboo's canonical S2=A ownership state, or reopen the closed matched-canonical S2 search. Upstream issue #902 is a promising planned first-party evaluation surface only; as reviewed, it contains no published results.
